title: Virgin Media fined after hanging up on customers trying to cancel contracts

facts.claim: Ofcom fined Virgin Media £28m for systematically preventing customers from cancelling service contracts through tactics including hanging up calls, excessive transfers, and pressure tactics over three-year period from 2022 to September 2024
facts.subject: Virgin Media
facts.cause: Millions of customer calls deliberately mishandled to prevent switching to competitors; commission scheme financially rewarded agents for these practices

title: Hundreds of jobs at risk in John Lewis' gift wrapping and money exchange services

facts.subject: John Lewis
facts.cause: Customers increasingly ordering foreign currency online and collecting in-store; increased use of credit cards and digital payments while abroad

facts.subject: John Lewis
facts.cause: Modernization to meet changing customer needs
